question_type: [Single Choice] Select the best answer based on your privacy persona.

response_options.A: The group that runs their company's internal computer network
response_options.C: A coworker who uses the same computer
response_options.D: The websites they visit while in private browsing mode

explanation: Private/incognito mode only prevents local browser history from being saved on the device. Network administrators, ISPs, and visited websites can still observe the traffic. This is a common and critical misconception about privacy protection.
